import html # Template used to render a blog post. The placeholders are replaced with # sanitized values before returning the final string. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_blog_post(title: str, body: str) -> str: """ Render a user‑generated blog post safely for display in HTML. Parameters ---------- title : str The title of the blog post. body : str The main content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized title and body inserted into ``BLOG_FORMAT``. Raises ------ TypeError If either *title* or *body* is not a string. """ if not isinstance(title, str) or not isinstance(body, str): raise TypeError("title and body must be strings") # Escape all special HTML characters to prevent injection attacks safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) # Insert the sanitized values into the template rendered = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return rendered.strip()
